instruction: My amazon package that is to be delivered today was an order for Anita. Request them the money for it on venmo.
notes: Three real apps (amazon, phone, venmo) plus supervisor. The order delivered today is identified via amazon.show_orders (known-id) and its total cost via amazon.show_order (found-order-cost). Anita's email is looked up in the phone contact book (phone.search_contacts with query 'Anita'); venmo.search_users would be an equivalent alternative. The venmo payment request action requires the discovered email, the order being for that person, and the discovered order cost; no description is used since the task does not ask for one. Goal is the single payment request to Anita for the order total; supervisor-complete-task carries the person/amount as non-API record parameters so its precondition is the lifted goal, and it is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on all other actions. token-for is a naming device so each app logs in with its own token object.
